summary:
Completed comprehensive investigation and architecture design for native DELEGATE
queue processing. Framework design is solid (SPEC.md, AGENTS.md, SKILLs exist).
Main implementation gap is the Orchestrator, which needs: queue discovery polling,
DELEGATE validation integration, routing decision implementation, HANDBACK reception,
Quality Engineer integration, span capture, and dead-letter queue handling.

Created 331-line investigation document covering all 10 acceptance criteria with
detailed findings, gaps analysis, and 4-phase implementation roadmap (15-20 hours).

acceptance_verified.AC1: PASS - Queue discovery mechanism documented with session-partitioned queue paths
acceptance_verified.AC2: PASS - DELEGATE validation documented with Group A/B/C rules and spec file requirement
acceptance_verified.AC3: PASS - Routing decision tree documented with complexity/scope criteria
acceptance_verified.AC4: PASS - HANDBACK reception format and metadata extraction specified
acceptance_verified.AC5: PASS - Quality gate architecture designed with QE role requirements
acceptance_verified.AC6: PASS - Span capture format (OpenTelemetry YAML) documented in detail
acceptance_verified.AC7: PASS - Dead-letter queue design with error logs and alerting specified
acceptance_verified.AC8: PASS - 10 critical implementation gaps identified and prioritized
acceptance_verified.AC9: PASS - 4-phase implementation roadmap with effort estimates provided
acceptance_verified.AC10: PASS - DELEGATE specification with minimal, complete, and role-specific examples
